Dickie & Ellis 1990 scan OCRs KE as 6-985 but the correct value is 6.895. Hay's worked examples reproduce 56040 d and 12404 d exactly only with 6.895, and the 1996 compendium appendix independently lists 6.895. The same scan renders sativa as saliva. Use 6.895.

Two VALID but non-interchangeable barley parameterisations. At 6.17 pct MC and -20 C the 1980b species-specific set gives 2453 y and the 1990 universal-CH/CQ set gives 671 y. Mixing 1980b KE/CW with universal CH/CQ gives a third wrong answer (1689 y). The engine must bind KE, CW, CH and CQ as one atomic parameter set per source row and never mix across rows.

CORRECTION. An earlier audit row claimed figshare agreed with WPSM at ~7,900/lb; that reference value was asserted from memory and never checked, and is wrong - it appears to have been sugar maple (Acer saccharum, WPSM 7,030/lb). The real WPSM silver maple figure is 1,780/lb, so the two sources disagree 4.6x. WPSM range is 900-3,200/lb, and figshare sits far outside it. The figshare record is annotated half-samara and was collected in Debrecen HU; prefer WPSM for this species and treat the figshare woody-species rows with caution.

Every extracted value is a kg/lb pair validated against the 2.2046 lb-per-kg invariant at 2 percent tolerance. Zero failures across 479 rows. This is the extraction criterion itself, so a value can only enter the file if its two published unit forms agree - which also makes it safe to scan pdftotext -layout, whose mis-alignments simply fail the test instead of producing bad data.

The Pinus chapter tabulates counts in THOUSANDS; read naively they are 1000x low. Detected via the (x1,000) header and scaled. Validated exactly against jack pine 131,000/lb, eastern white pine 26,000/lb and loblolly 18,000/lb.

No single pdftotext mode renders all WPSM tables. -table handles most; -layout adds row-major tables it mangles; -raw is the ONLY mode that linearises the column-major tables, which is how Picea (13 species) and Fraxinus (9) were recovered. All three modes are scanned and merged, with -table preferred on ties.

WPSM prints Sciatopitys; the accepted genus is Sciadopitys (Japanese umbrella pine). Left as printed in the CSV per the convention that extracted files reproduce their source, with the correction recorded here. Normalise on join.

These express seed counts in prose forms that bind to a common name rather than a binomial (e.g. "Scotch laburnum, 31,966 to 35,004/kg"). Attributing them would risk assigning a value to the wrong taxon, so they are dropped rather than guessed. 79 of 236 genera captured overall.

Neither is wrong; show both or pick one explicitly and say which. Never mix constants across the two rows.

Liquidambar styraciflua (-2.7 C and -15.8 C), Pinus elliottii (-16.1 C) and Pinus occidentalis (-8.2 C and -21.1 C) have CH and CQ whose quadratic peaks above -25 C. Below -CH/(2 CQ) the equation predicts colder storage shortens life. The compendium's own -20 C column is evaluated past the turning point for four of the five. The engine holds each set at its turning point and flags it.

The tool uses 47 mL; the 2015 figure (one third left at a year) reproduces the 2025 time points of 15, 10 and just above 5% within 0.2 points, so the time course is not in doubt, only the volume.
